lines.text: What if you asked every single gaming company in the world for a free gaming mouse?
lines.title: POV: you asked every gaming mouse brand for a FREE gaming mouse 🖱️😭

lines.text: I wanted to find out, so I made a giant list of all of their emails and I asked every single one for a free mouse.
lines.title: POV: you asked every gaming mouse brand for a FREE gaming mouse 🖱️😭

lines.text: In total, I emailed this many companies, and I had no idea that this many companies even made this.
So this many just gave me an auto-reply, which is pretty lame because it seems like AI's just doing most of the work in that.
This many didn't even send, so it looks like I'm blocked or their inbox just wasn't receiving it.
And this many actually just left me on delivered, which made me lose a lot of hope.
But after all that, these are how many responses I got.
And if you're wondering how I even emailed that many companies, I used this tool called Hedwig, and it found all the companies for me and sent all of those emails automatically.
Now, out of the companies that responded, this many said no, however, a bunch of them did send me some free stickers and even some discount codes, which is pretty sweet, I guess.
But the craziest part is this many actually said yes, and I genuinely don't know what to do with all of these gaming mice.
So if you want one, just follow me, comment below which company I should do next, and I'll just give out the mice to anyone who has zero likes under their comments.
